evidence: Matches the IPC label, touches `src/ipc/capnp/protocol.cpp`, and directly alters multiprocess connection and event loop lifecycle handling.
rationale: Fixes race conditions and potential crashes during event loop shutdown and parent disconnect handling in multiprocess mode. The PR description notes that methods called from other threads access `m_loop` without synchronization and depend unsafely on the parent connection remaining alive to prevent premature loop exit, directly targeting crash and disconnect reliability in IPC infrastructure.
